name: IQ Bell Curve
look: A blue IQ bell curve chart with percentages over each section and IQ scores from 55 to 145 along the bottom. A grinning, simple wojak face sits at the low left end, a crying wojak in glasses at the peak in the middle, and a calm hooded figure at the high right end.
use: Mocks overthinking. The low-IQ character and the hooded genius say the same simple thing, while the crying average person in the middle argues a long, overcomplicated take.
slots: the overcomplicated, anxious take (crying wojak, middle)
the same simple take again (hooded figure, right)
examples: Just turn it off and on again
Actually you need to update the drivers, clear the cache and reinstall the firmware
Just turn it off and on again
Sleep is for the weak, I can grind 20 hours a day
